ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Chrome Frame Helper DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "chrome_frame_helper.dll" Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\chrome\\_frame\\_helper\\\.dll$") AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Google\\\\Chrome\\\\Application\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Google\\\\Chrome\\\\Application\\\\"))) AND  NOT (ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\local\\\\Google\\\\Chrome\\\\Application\\\\.*"))
